in_hebrew.name: לינדי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'leyn' which means 'light' or 'shining', and the suffix 'dy' which is derived from 'dod' meaning 'beloved'.

in_greek.name: Λύνδυ
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'lyndos' or 'lynos' which means 'wolf' or 'lion'. The name Lyndy may have been given to a child born during a time of war or to represent strength and courage.

in_latin.name: Lynthia
in_latin.long_meaning: Latin form of the Greek name 'Lynthos' or 'Lynos', meaning 'wolf' or 'lion'.
